names = [
    "January",
    "February",
    "March",
    "April",
    "May",
    "June",
    "July",
    "August",
    "September",
    "October",
    "November",
    "December",
]
offsets = [0, 3, 2, 5, 0, 3, 5, 1, 4, 6, 2, 4]
for index, (year, month) in enumerate([(2024, 2), (2026, 8), (2026, 11)]):
    if index:
        print()
    adjusted = year - (month < 3)
    weekday = (
        adjusted
        + adjusted // 4
        - adjusted // 100
        + adjusted // 400
        + offsets[month - 1]
        + 1
    ) % 7
    leap = year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)
    lengths = [31, 29 if leap else 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    print(f"{names[month - 1]} {year}")
    print("Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa")
    fields = ["  "] * weekday + [
        f"{day:2d}" for day in range(1, lengths[month - 1] + 1)
    ]
    for start in range(0, len(fields), 7):
        print(" ".join(fields[start : start + 7]))
